rows.text: • Full-year adjusted EPS outlook raised to $6.55 - $6.65 and cash flow outlook raised to $800 - $900 million
Textron raised its expectation for full-year 2026 GAAP earnings per share from continuing operations to be in the range of $5.64 to $5.74, up from our previous outlook of $5.39 to $5.59.
